# TextInputType

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum TextInputType
```

Hint to the platform's text-input pipeline (soft keyboard layout, IME mode, autocapitalization defaults). Mirrors common conventions across SDL3, HTML `<input>`, UIKit `UIKeyboardType`, and Android `EditorInfo.inputType`.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="text"></a>`Text = 0` | Plain text. Default soft keyboard. |
| <a name="password"></a>`Password` | Obscured text entry (passwords, PINs). |
| <a name="number"></a>`Number` | Integer numeric entry. Digits only. |
| <a name="decimal"></a>`Decimal` | Decimal numeric entry. Digits, decimal separator, sign. |
| <a name="phone"></a>`Phone` | Telephone number entry. |
| <a name="email"></a>`Email` | Email address entry. |
| <a name="url"></a>`Url` | URL entry. |
| <a name="search"></a>`Search` | Search query entry. |
